text:
[LGRA.9.7.1] Primary productions:

```
primary ::= literal
         |  NAME                                               # binding / constant / type reference — classified by position (LGRA.22)
         |  '(' expression ')'

literal ::= INT_LIT
         |  FLOAT_LIT
         |  STRING_LIT
         |  UNIT_LIT
         |  BOOL_LIT
```

Function calls are not a primary alternative — they're a postfix
form, `primary postfix_op*` where `postfix_op` includes
`'(' argument_list? ')'` per [LGRA.9.6]. So `len(x)` parses as
the `NAME` `len` followed by a `(...)` postfix. The type-headed
coercion call forms (`Json(x)` / `Float(x)` / `Int(x)`) are
**removed** — a conversion is written with the `::` cast
(`x::Json`) — per [LGRA.9.7.3] and [LCST.4.6].
